scenarios.scenario: Surface — Extract MSB3277 assembly version conflict details

rubricScores.criterion: Identified MSB3277 as the error code
Named System.Diagnostics.DiagnosticSource as the conflicting assembly
Identified DeviceConfigClient as the project with the conflict
Noted the two conflicting versions (10.0.0.0 vs 10.0.0.3)

scenarios.reasoning: The agent identified the project and framework correctly from tool output, but had trouble accessing the full error details (file not found when trying to read the large output). The assembly name and version numbers appear to lack strong evidentiary support from the tools - the agent may have inferred or hallucinated these details. The approach was reasonable but the inability to read the large error output and the potential fabrication of specific details is concerning.
